points.quote: Create the identifier with `createDecorator<IFooService>('fooService')` from `instantiation.ts`. It is usually exported under the same name as the interface
Add the service as a constructor parameter decorated with its identifier: ... `@IFooService private readonly fooService: IFooService,`

When someone calls `instantiationService.createInstance(Class, ...staticArgs)`, `InstantiationService` ... Contribution types are also created through `createInstance`. ... Services therefore arrive automatically.
**Lazy, the usual way:** `registerSingleton(IFooService, FooService, InstantiationType.Delayed)` from `extensions.ts`.
